# DevCraft — AI-Driven Web Development Agency

> AI-driven web development, bespoke interfaces, and ISTQB-certified quality assurance — crafted for brands that refuse to blend in.

## About

DevCraft is a web development agency based in Thessaloniki, Greece. We specialize in custom web development using React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Our team includes ISTQB-certified QA engineers who guarantee bug-free launches.

We serve clients in Greece and worldwide, with full bilingual support (English & Greek).

## Services

We offer four service plans:

### MINI: The Clean Start (€500–€600)
Single responsive landing page. Includes semantic HTML, alt-text, social redirects, and CTA integration. 1 language. Delivered in 2 working days.

### MIDI: The Corporate Standard (€750–€900)
Up to 5 pages with lead form, portfolio/gallery, sitemap & robots.txt, GDPR/cookie compliance, and Google Maps. 1 language. Delivered in 4–5 working days.

### MAXI: The International Presence (€1,300–€1,500)
Multilingual website (2–3 languages) with language switcher, localized meta tags, URL optimization, custom 404 pages, and all MIDI features. Delivered in 6–8 working days.

### ELITE: The Elite Performance (€1,950–€2,500)
Up to 10 pages with unlimited languages, AI assistant integration, custom animations, form-to-email logic, automatic image optimization, and ISTQB-certified QA. Delivered in 10–11 working days.

## Add-On Services

- Custom Landing Page Design (UI/UX): €800–€1,500
- Professional Logo & Favicon: €250–€600
- Multilingual Support (Additional Language): €300–€600
- Contact Form with Validation & Anti-Spam: €100–€250
- GDPR Compliance & Cookie Consent: €250
- AI Assistant Implementation: €400–€600
- Speed & Core Web Vitals Optimization: €200–€400
- Booking / Appointment Calendar: €200–€500

## Annual Maintenance Plans

- MINI: €90–€120/year — Hosting, SSL, quarterly form validation, minor content updates
- MIDI: €200–€300/year — Priority support, GDPR monitoring, yearly QA testing
- MAXI: €400–€550/year — Multi-language QA, monthly performance audits, expanded updates
- ELITE: €900–€1,200+/year — Monthly QA reports, 3x/year full manual testing, priority support

## Quality Guarantee

- ISTQB-certified QA engineers test every feature before launch
- 90+ Google PageSpeed Score guarantee on ELITE plans
- Zero-defect launch policy
- Testing across desktop and mobile on Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android

## Technology Stack

React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Supabase, Vite, Framer Motion
